sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Repair the comparison to enforce the required reasonable safety margin by using componentYieldSafetyFactor as an actual formula operand (for example, stress × safetyFactor <= component material yield strength), rather than merely requiring the factor and testing stress <= yield. Do not require both direct materialYieldStrength and linked componentMaterialYieldStrength for the same component; retain the canonical hasMaterialProperties -> componentMaterialYieldStrength path used by the comparison and remove the redundant direct yield-strength requirement.
